== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Lieutenant Cecius (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1261_16</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-12-Lieutenant_Cecius.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-lieutenantcecius-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Lieutenant Cecius (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Opponent's characters are deploy +1 to same mobile site. At battlegrounds where you have a unique (•) and non-unique Imperial present (and no other bonus to your Force drain), your Force drains are +1. Tactical Support is a Used Interrupt.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number, copyright line) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-12-Lieutenant_Cecius-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B09 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
